annual.cash_basis: CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents (includes restricted cash — no separate tag; net debt understated)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2009-12-31..2026-06-30; paid facts exist only inside that span and are not used; the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2024-12-31) is 546 days older than the declared tag's (2026-06-30) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buybacks.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

legs.buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters

buyback_yield.note: buybacks not filed for the window — null

legs.buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.note: buybacks not filed for the window — null

legs.buybacks: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.label: ≥ 5.20%

notes: annual_dps: FY2013, FY2014, FY2015, FY2016, FY2017 = sum of the four filed quarterly DPS facts (no FY fact)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 1.44 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.36, 2026-06-30: 0.36) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.36, 2025-06-30: 0.36)
buybacks_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed buybacks figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
